thread:
Nell: Dropped a refreshed launch blog draft (v6) in Drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/s/launch-v6. Need quick sign-off on hero variant, CTA microcopy, and social teaser lines. Can we close this thread by noon?

Priya: Skimming now. Two hero variants: A) 'Production-grade inference at predictable cost' B) 'Fast, reliable LLM inference for apps'. Which should we run as primary?

Arman-Growth: Prefer A for enterprise clarity, but B might be better for social. Could we swap for social-only hero B in OG meta and keep A on page?

Ken: HubSpot forms: propose 'launch_webinar_v6' and 'launch_api_v6' as form IDs. UTMs: utm_campaign=launch_q4_v6, utm_source=blog, utm_medium=organic. Social teasers need an explicit ?src=social param for cross-channel attribution.

Zoe: Design asks: need final hero copy by 11am to export OGs (1200x628) + three hero PNG sizes. Also want the short social lines (<=140 chars).

Ivy-Legal: Quick legal note: flagged phrase "predictable cost" — fine if we qualify with context. Also numeric benchmarks must include footnote: 'Benchmarks measured on Redwood internal harness; results may vary.' Please add that footnote inline after numbers.

Priya: For CTAs exact copy pick: 1) 'Register for live demo' & 'Start free API trial' OR 2) 'Save your seat' & 'Create a free API key'. I'm leaning #1. Also add microcopy under webinar CTA: 'Seats limited; recording provided.'

Nell: Locking to #1 for CTAs. We'll show OG hero variant B for social only per Arman. Zoe pls ensure OG copy differs.

Ken: I'll create HS forms and tags: 'blog_launch_v6_webinar' and 'blog_launch_v6_api'. I'll set hidden field 'referrer' and preserve UTMs. Zapier will apply tag 'launch_blog_v6'.

Ivy-Legal: LGTM on the qualifier and footnote. Exact footnote text to use: 'Benchmarks measured on Redwood internal harness; results may vary.'

Arman-Growth: Social teasers (first drafts):
- Twitter: "Ship LLM features with predictable inference economics. Join our live demo -> [link]"
- LinkedIn: "Today we announce a new inference runtime focused on cost, latency, and reliability. Register for a live demo or start a free trial."
Please shorten Twitter to <=140 chars.

Zoe: Uploading OGs and hero PNGs by 11:45. Will create separate OG for social with hero B. Also exporting a 1080x1080 variant for ads.

Maria-ops: Ops checklist: cap webinar at 300 live seats; overflow -> recording + two office hours. I need final copy + HS form IDs by 3pm PT to stage registration page for 2pm PT publish day. Also confirm embargo: launch day 2pm PT next Tuesday?

Nell: Correct, embargo lift 2pm PT next Tuesday. Maria-ops please stage at 8:30am that day.

Priya: LGTM marketing. Tiny copy tweak: change first sentence from "We're excited" -> "Today we're announcing".

Ken: LGTM tracking. Forms queued. Will ping once live.

Ivy-Legal: LGTM legal. Footnote included in doc and captions.

Zoe: LGTM design. Uploads in progress.

Maria-ops: LGTM ops. Will schedule and confirm preview URL by EOD.

Nell: Thanks all ":thumbsup:" Once Maria posts the preview URL I'll wire CTAs and hand to Growth for distribution.
